v2_test_continuation.gamma_floor_rule: Clamp the pre-locked V2 score-to-gamma mapping to the allowed 0.5-1.0 range before inference; preserve and hash the original frozen policy separately.

v3_development.score_normalization_and_decile_boundarie: fit inputs only, independently for each model

three_group_policy.gamma_selection: Select each group's gamma independently from fit outcomes using the registered utility; no accuracy gate.

feature_risk_policy.normalization_and_risk_decile_boundaries: fit inputs only, independently for each model
feature_risk_policy.risk_score_weights: equal weight across six standardized input features
fallback_when: any input feature is outside its fit q1-q99 envelope
an assigned group has fewer than 30 in-envelope fit rows

candidate_policy_families: fit-optimized nondecreasing gamma by score decile
fit-optimized independent gamma by score decile within the registered easy/medium/hard bands
fit-optimized independent gamma by easy/medium/hard difficulty group over gamma 0.5-1.0
fit-optimized independent gamma by six-feature risk group with input-only fallback
v3_development.tuning_selection: Select among all four registered V3 policy families using tuning utility; break ties by higher accuracy, then prefer the three-group policy, the nondecreasing decile policy, the independent decile policy, and the feature-risk fallback policy, then higher gamma values.
v3_development.validation_role: One-time reporting after policy freeze; no policy change or run gate.
v3_development.test_policy_selection: Use the tuning-selected policy frozen before any GSM8K test inference.
v3_development.test_routing_contract: Question-only inputs; exactly one selected gamma and one generation per test row; no test answers, rationales, or correctness for fitting or policy selection.

utility.interpretation: A 10 percentage-point CoT-token reduction offsets 1 percentage point of accuracy in the policy-selection ranking.
utility.use: Ranking and policy selection only; not a pass/fail threshold or an accuracy gate.
